findings.passage: Rep. Mike Cabell, R-Butler Township, along with the rest of the Luzerne County Republican delegation — reps. Aaron Kaufer, R-Kingston; Alec Ryncavage, R-Plymouth; and Dane Watro, R-Hazleton — on Wednesday said that they have signed the House discharge petition to get a voter ID constitutional amendment out of committee and before the full House of Representatives for a vote in the near future.
findings.motion: Signed House discharge petition to move a voter ID constitutional amendment out of committee
findings.note: Times Leader report (reporter's words, not his own) that he signed a discharge petition for a voter ID constitutional amendment. Quotes in the article are from another member.
